has_api_key.instructions: Does this snippet contain a hardcoded API key, access key, or similar credential string?

criteria.true: A hardcoded API or access key is present

has_bearer_token.instructions: Does this snippet contain a hardcoded bearer token, JWT, session token, or OAuth token?

criteria.true: A hardcoded bearer or session token is present

has_password.instructions: Does this snippet contain a hardcoded password, passphrase, or PIN in source?

criteria.true: A hardcoded password or passphrase is present

has_private_key.instructions: Does this snippet contain a private key, PEM block, SSH key, or signing key material?

has_connection_string.instructions: Does this snippet contain a database or service connection string with embedded credentials?

criteria.true: A connection string with embedded credentials is present

has_email_pii.instructions: Does this snippet contain what appears to be a real personal email address (not example.com or obvious placeholder)?

criteria.true: A plausible personal email address is present

has_account_id.instructions: Does this snippet contain a hardcoded account ID, customer ID, SSN, or other sensitive account identifier?

criteria.true: A sensitive account or customer identifier is present
